name: zfmv_stream_open_audio
description: zFMV_Stream::OpenAudio opens the optional AVI audio stream, reads format and stream metadata, creates either a queued streaming sample or a full-buffer sample according to mode flags, and leaves audio state disabled when no audio stream is present.
known_limits: The direct smoke covers the no-audio-stream early return used by missing/non-audio AVI inputs. Positive audio stream setup is accepted compositionally from Binary Ninja evidence plus accepted zSndSample_CreateQueuedStreamingSample and Video-for-Windows provider boundaries.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV stream/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4641a0 validates the AVIStreamOpenFromFileA audio probe, format-size/read and stream-info error reporting, streaming/full-buffer branch controlled by modeFlags, buffer allocation/read counts based on sample size and stream length, queued sample creation, refill/read-index fields, and hasAudioStream flag writes.
The native smoke verifies that a missing audio stream clears the audio stream pointer and returns without disturbing mode flags or forcing hasAudioStream true.
